'''Aquamarine Flask''' is a [[utility flask]] base type. __NOTOC__

==Modifiers==
{{Main|List of modifiers for utility flasks}}

==Mechanics==
The [[radius]] of the [[chilled ground]] created on use is 28, and cannot be modified.

[[Freeze]] is an [[ailment]] that slows the [[action speed]] by 100%. With this flask active, it is possible to still move, cast spells and attack even while frozen, with the action speed being lowered to 60% instead of 0%.
Modifiers to [[Flask#Passive Skills|flask effect]] can further increase this value.

Aquamarine flask can potentially be a potent choice for "self-freeze" character builds, countering the negative consequences of not being able to act at all. Specified builds utilize niche freeze-related modifiers found on some unique items (like {{il|Winterheart}} or {{il|Izaro's Dilemma}}).

{{Item unique versions}}

{{Item acquisition}}

==Ruthless mode==
Utility Flasks cannot gain charges while active in [[Ruthless mode]]. This flask also has a flask duration of 5.50 seconds instead.
